solution_title: Field Workforce Geofenced Attendance & Site Audit Router
summary: Cohesive split-screen Austin field workforce attendance and multi-site store audit planning application across all 8 web frameworks. On load, it initializes a 2D Google Map centered on Austin (30.2672, -97.7431, zoom 12) with mapId="DEMO_MAP_ID" and internalUsageAttributionIds=["gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0"], renders 3 pre-seeded Austin client site geofence polygons, mounts a Terra Draw polygon drawing toolbar (terra-draw + terra-draw-google-maps-adapter) so supervisors can draw/edit new polygon geofence zones, evaluates simulated worker GPS presets (inside vs. outside polygons) via google.maps.geometry.poly.containsLocation to unlock or lock the Verified Clock-In badge, reverse-geocodes the worker's coordinates into a street address via Geocoder (client stacks) or /api/geocode/reverse (BFF stacks), discovers live Austin audit sites via Place.searchByText("retail stores in Austin, TX") or /api/places/search, and computes/renders an optimized multi-stop driving route with numbered AdvancedMarkerElement pins via Route.computeRoutes (optimizeWaypointOrder: true) or /api/routes/compute. Zero deprecated APIs (no google.maps.Marker, PlacesService, DirectionsService, or google.maps.drawing).
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (maps, marker, places, routes, geocoding, geometry libraries)
Routes API (v2) — Compute Routes with Waypoint Optimization
ui_layout_summary: Top header bar (56px) displaying title, Austin district badge, active geofence count, clock-in eligibility pill, and route ETA/distance summary. Below header, a responsive split-screen workspace: left Operations Sidebar (380px width) with 3 cards—(1) Worker GPS & Geofenced Attendance (preset selector with inside/outside Austin coordinates, geofence entry/exit status pill, live reverse-geocoded street address, and Verified Clock-In badge/button), (2) Geofence Zones & Terra Draw Controls (Draw Polygon, Select/Edit, Clear Drawn buttons synced with map overlay toolbar, plus zone list showing pre-seeded and newly drawn polygons), and (3) Multi-Stop Audit Router (live Places Text Search input, Optimize Route button, ordered audit stops list reflecting optimized waypoint indices, and route totals); right Map Canvas (flex: 1, min-height: 520px) featuring a top-left floating Terra Draw toolbar, pre-seeded + supervisor-drawn geofence polygons, simulated worker AdvancedMarkerElement, numbered audit stop AdvancedMarkerElements with InfoWindows, and the optimized driving route polyline.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Server-side Places API (New) Text Search proxy to fetch live Austin audit site candidates on initial load and supervisor searches with explicit X-Goog-Api-Key and X-Goog-FieldMask headers.

Server-side Routes API v2 computeRoutes proxy with optimizeWaypointOrder=true and TRAFFIC_AWARE routingPreference to compute the optimized multi-stop audit itinerary, leg metrics, and encoded polyline.
Server-side Geocoding API v4 reverse geocoding proxy converting simulated worker lat/lng coordinates into a human-readable Austin street address.
